decisions.reason: Although it is close to our existing finishing know-how, its disappearance from the website by 2024 suggests weak enough market feedback that our absorptive capacity is better used on stronger adjacent products.

Because UV spot varnishing is relatively distant from our established postpress knowledge base and the product vanished from the website after its 2023 premiere, we are unlikely to learn and improve it efficiently enough to justify keeping it.

This module builds directly on our established offer and remained presented on its own page through 2024, indicating a good fit with our knowledge base and enough ongoing market relevance to keep developing and selling it.

Even though the B2 multifinisher is close to our core capabilities, its loss of visibility after the 2023 launch points to limited traction or priority, so resources should be reallocated to adjacent products with clearer evidence of demand.

The hybrid saddle stitcher fits our existing portfolio, but its removal from the website by 2024 signals insufficient momentum, and under an absorptive-capacity view we should concentrate on nearby products where learning is still visibly accumulating.

This folding add-on is closely related to our installed base and was still mentioned in 2024 with a concrete customer application, showing that we can absorb user feedback and commercialize improvements effectively.
